notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
We've just uploaded an update to Shrug Island - The Meeting. It has the following additions and improvements:


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12089059/60cbcf4ef1cd9dd2524d4290dd9a362cab056783.png[/img]

[h1]PauseGame/Quit/GotoMenu is now accessible everywhere[/h1]
Press escape button on your keyboard. This option to was previously accessible only via the map (itself available from the fourth level of the game and onwards).


[h1]Dialogue GUI/triangle icon now has states[/h1] These visualize if the player has or hasn’t accessed all hints at a given moment. Note: More, greyer lines of unread text may still be hidden behind an empty dialogue icon; these are random non-puzzle related story rhymes, and are not counted by the interface.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12089059/38789cf09c1eba582490fc6f183fca0546ef3ec1.png[/img]


 [h1]Frame rate fix[/h1] It is now locked at 60 fps.

[h1]Various[/h1] Visual polishing and audio balancing.



We hope you enjoy it.
[url=http://www.twitter.com/tinyredcamel]@TinyRedCamel[/url]
